_comment: Official Palloliitto rule documents shown in the Säännöt modal. This file is the SINGLE source: the modal renders it and scripts/check-rule-links.mjs verifies it weekly in CI. Palloliitto re-issues these PDFs under NEW asset ids and leaves the old file served, so a dead link is not the failure mode - a link that still loads a superseded edition is. That is why every entry that Palloliitto lists on its rules index carries onIndexPage: true; the check fails when the URL stops appearing there, which is what supersession actually looks like. Add a link here, not in the component.

links.note: Announced from a news article rather than the rules index, so reachability is all the check can assert. Replaces the Kaikki Pelaa programme link: Palloliitto delisted that PDF and the age-group rules it carried now live per season and per series.
